title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer,

translated_title: Waypoint-OPD：通过门控同策略蒸馏迁移强化学习引起的策略变化
translated_abstract: 策略偏移蒸馏将教师模型在强化学习（RL）前后对数概率之间的差异作为监督信号，应用于学生模型生成的轨迹上。然而，这种端点策略偏移无法揭示教师训练过程中局部动作偏好是否持续一致地演化。相同的端点偏移可能来自早期与晚期偏移的相互加强或部分抵消。我们研究了早期与晚期教师策略偏移之间的一致性能否指导选择性迁移。我们提出了路点引导的同策略蒸馏（Waypoint-OPD），该方法利用同一RL运行中的中间教师检查点，在学生访问的前缀处比较早期与晚期相对动作偏好的变化。我们根据早期与晚期偏移之间的方向一致性对端点偏移进行门控，当两者方向相反时予以抑制。与仅迁移端点偏移的方法相比，……
tldr: Waypoint-OPD创新性地引入中间教师检查点，利用早期与晚期策略偏移的方向一致性对端点偏移进行门控筛选，从而在学生生成的轨迹上实现更可靠的选择性策略迁移。
en_tdlr: Waypoint-OPD introduces an intermediate teacher checkpoint and gates the endpoint policy shift based on the directional agreement between early and late shifts, enabling more reliable selective on-policy distillation of RL-induced policy changes.
